app.name: reVC: Vice City Wii
app.short_description: GTA Vice City port for Wii
app.long_description:
reVC Wii port (reverse-engineered Vice City) running on libogc.
Assets: stock PC Vice City data on USB (NTFS ok) or SD at {device}:/apps/reVC. Character roster, radio and scripted audio open straight from the PC install; no conversion step.
Hardware: GameCube controller, Wiimote+Nunchuck (auto-aim) and Classic Controller supported.
Audio: MP3/ADPCM streams decoded natively, waveform lengths cached on SD (wii_sound.cache) after the first boot.
Diagnostics: an on-screen boot banner prints the build it is running, and debug.log beside the DOL records the boot ladder, VFS failures, streaming progress and heap state - leave it on the SD when reporting a hang.
HOLD HOME to exit. Saves write to sd:/apps/reVC.
